using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Orleans.Configuration;

namespace Orleans.Hosting
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Validator for AdoNet grain storage options.
    /// </summary>
    public class AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator : IConfigurationValidator
    {
        private readonly AdoNetGrainStorageOptions _options;
        private readonly string _name;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="options">The options to validate.</param>
        /// <param name="name">The name of the options.</param>
        public AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator(AdoNetGrainStorageOptions options, string name)
        {
            _options = options;
            _name = name;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Validates the options.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="context">The validation context.</param>
        public void Validate(Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.ConnectionString))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Connection string for {_name} is not set.");
            }

            if (_options.DataContextType == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Data context type for {_name} is not set.");
            }

            if (_options.DataContextFactoryType == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Data context factory type for {_name} is not set.");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.DataContextFactoryMethod))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Data context factory method for {_name} is not set.");
            }
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Orleans.Hosting;
using Xunit;

public class AdoNetGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddAdoNetGrainStorage_WithValidOptions_DoesNotThrow()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act
        services.AddAdoNetGrainStorage("test", ob => ob.Configure(options =>
        {
            options.ConnectionString = "test";
            options.DataContextType = typeof(object);
            options.DataContextFactoryType = typeof(object);
            options.DataContextFactoryMethod = "test";
        }));

        // Assert
        Assert.DoesNotThrow(() => services.BuildServiceProvider());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAdoNetGrainStorage_WithInvalidOptions_Throws()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act and Assert
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => services.AddAdoNetGrainStorage("test", ob => ob.Configure(options =>
        {
            options.ConnectionString = null;
            options.DataContextType = typeof(object);
            options.DataContextFactoryType = typeof(object);
            options.DataContextFactoryMethod = "test";
        })));
    }
}
